subject: SIG questionnaire — final artifacts and next-steps
body:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@hopewell-health.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@hopewell-health.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request and artifacts for Hopewell security review

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team opened the formal SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) for Redwood as part of our procurement packet. Can you confirm whether you can: 1) complete the SIG spreadsheet sections marked as "In-scope for hosting/serving"; 2) share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report, the 3rd-party penetration test executive summary, and your ISO statements; and 3) provide an updated security deck we can circulate internally?

Timeline: our procurement window closes on Oct 20, so having the documents and a completed SIG by Oct 12 would be ideal. If there are items you cannot share, please indicate redactions and a short rationale.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Director, IT Security
Hopewell Health

---

On Mon, 05 Oct 2026 13:02:11 -0400
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@hopewell-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 13:02:11 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG request and artifacts for Hopewell security review

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can meet your Oct 12 target for the SIG and core artifacts. Plan below:

- SIG spreadsheet: we will complete all "In-scope for hosting/serving" tabs and flag any items that require a gated process (e.g., on-prem customer data export requests).
- SOC 2 Type II (2025): we can provide the full report under an NDA; executive summary + control matrix we can share now.
- Pen test: we will share the executive summary and mitigation timeline; full pentest report requires an NDA and MSA addendum.
- ISO statements: we will provide the ISO 27001 statement of applicability and scope page.
- Security deck: share latest v4 with one-slide summary for procurement distribution.

Deliverables targeted by Oct 12 (attachments below): 
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (executive summary + controls matrix)
- pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (exec summary + open/closed items)
- ISO27001_statement.pdf
- redwood_security_deck_v4.pptx
- SIG-completed-Hopewell.xlsx (we will mark redactions inline where applicable)

Marissa — please confirm the attachments are the latest exports and that SIG-completed includes auditor notes where needed. Karthik — FYI on the NDA gating items (we may route the full SOC and pen test under our standard compliance NDA).

Daniel — if that plan works I will upload the artifacts to the secure Drive link and send the SIG spreadsheet by EOD Oct 12. If you prefer a short review call, I have availability on Oct 8 between 10–11am PT.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Rachel / team,

Received everything — thank you. The SOC2 exec summary and pen test summary look good for our procurement packet. A couple of small clarifications we noted in the SIG spreadsheet (items 7.2, 9.1) — I'll add comments directly in the sheet. We may need the full SOC report for legal review, at which point we'll sign the standard vendor NDA you outlined.

We also want to schedule a 30-minute call next Tuesday (10/13) to walk the security team through a couple of controls. Can you confirm availability? If not, we can do 10/14.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Daniel
